newsitem.title: CHINA: China to set up industry investment funds.
newsitem.headline: China to set up industry investment funds.

text.p: China will soon set up a national industry investment fund to help individuals invest in industrial projects and is considering applications for similar regional funds on a trial basis, the Business News said on Wednesday.

The newspaper quoted Zhang Dongshen, an official from the State Planning Commission, as saying individuals would be allowed to invest in industry through mutual funds with no restrictions on which industries the funds could invest in.
"Many provinces have applied to set up industry investment funds and the concerned government departments are studying the applications," the newspaper said.
"It is expected that the first batch of such funds will be announced shortly after the Chinese lunar new year," it said.
The newspaper gave no other details.
This year's lunar new year falls on February 7.
